facts.fact: Executive Suite 前台是一只幻灵，它用脸上两个黑洞般的眼窝盯着 Daniel。
facts.anchor: The specter at the Executive Suite reception desk stares up at me owlishly

facts.fact: 传唤书是 Daniel 今早回自己房间时在信箱里发现的，他被要求下午一点到岗。
facts.anchor: I show it the summons I found in my mail slot when I stumbled back home early this morning.

facts.fact: Accounts Receivable 今早出了状况，Executives 因此开了一整天的会，他只能在等候室干等。
facts.anchor: There was an emergency in Accounts Receivable this morning. It has kept them in meetings all day.

facts.fact: CEO 亲自走进等候室，说的第一句话是 “Hello, Friend.”，Daniel 当场判断自己完了。
新文书要求在它生成后四天内把 Lucy 的灵魂收回。
facts.anchor: Her soul MUST be returned to us within four days following the creation of this document

facts.fact: 文书指定她的死法：地点在 Riverton 的 Douglas 与 Midway 路口，事发时间 8:43，方式是从市公交车上，死亡 8:44。
下周一 CEO 将与 Lucifer 一起处理 Daniel 的降级。
facts.anchor: Next Monday, we will meet with you and Lucifer to discuss your demotion.

facts.fact: 他的房间简陋压抑，却是 135 年来他唯一住过的地方。
facts.anchor: My room is spare and depressing, but it’s the only home I’ve had for 135 years.
